question: Locate the pinned MON 95275 x MON 88017 notice whose Date of Issuance is 3/18/2025, and find its printed EPA registration number. Use that number to select the original PPIS PRODUCT row and interpret its cancellation fields with the pinned dictionary. What separate cancellation or transfer effective date is explicitly stated in that notice/label packet? Do not substitute the issuance date or infer an event from the snapshot sentinel.

evidence.locator: PDF page 1, EPA registration-number, Date of Issuance or product-name field (registration)
PDF page 1, EPA registration-number, Date of Issuance or product-name field (issuance)
PDF page 1, EPA registration-number, Date of Issuance or product-name field (product)
evidence.quote: Name of Pesticide Product: MON 95275 x MON 88017

evidence.locator: Original PRODUCT.TXT fixed-width row REG_NR 00052400667, byte offset 1521112; zero-based CAN_DATE [22:30], CT_CODE [30:32]
PPIS dictionary physical page 13, PRODUCT cancellation-date and reason-code joint active-product sentinel
evidence.quote: Active products have a blank CT_CODE and CAN_DATE of 00000000.

notes: Root reviewed every original native selector and complete fixed-width row, independently rehashing source pins and checking raw byte offsets/field widths. Product name plus printed issuance selects the notice; its registration number selects the raw zero-padded REG_NR. Only the joint blank CT_CODE / CAN_DATE 00000000 sentinel has dictionary-defined active-snapshot semantics. It corroborates the missing explicit date in this pinned packet; it does not prove no historical cancellation, current legal status, an event date or continued authorization. Issuance is not cancellation. Complete dataset-wide absence probes must pass, including previously reviewed complete OCR for scan packets. Publication is the latest required source proxy at the weakest confidence. Original product-name typography may differ across label and row; join only on the verified number. No missing row is used as absence.
